intro: Paraguay has about 7 million people, and most speak both Spanish and Guaraní.

chapters.title: People
text: Spanish and Guaraní are both official, and most people mix them in Jopara. Most Paraguayans are of mixed descent, and there are Mennonite communities in the Chaco.

chapters.title: Asunción
text: Asunción, the capital, is one of South America's oldest cities.

keyTerms.meaning: A mix of Guaraní and Spanish.
